fields.name: blue_cube_pos
fields.description: The [y, x] position of the blue cube as it was seen before the containers came down, i.e. the position shown at step #1 (t=0) while the cubes are still visible. Written at step #1 and held unchanged for the rest of the episode, even after the cube is hidden by a container or briefly re-exposed when a container is lifted. e.g. [128, 141]

fields.name: green_cube_pos
fields.description: The [y, x] position of the green cube as it was seen at step #1 (t=0) before the containers came down. Written at step #1 and held unchanged for the rest of the episode. e.g. [88, 106]

fields.name: red_cube_pos
fields.description: The [y, x] position of the red cube as it was seen at step #1 (t=0) before the containers came down. Written at step #1 and held unchanged for the rest of the episode. e.g. [130, 79]

fields.name: picks_done
fields.description: Count of container pick-ups completed so far. 0 at step #1. Increases by one at the decision step whose execution steps show a container held in the gripper (the step right after a 'pick up the container' subgoal was executed). It does not change when the container is put down. e.g. 1
